Class DateTimeUtils

java.lang.Object
am.gortsup.testing.util.DateTimeUtils
public final class DateTimeUtils extends Object
Date and time computation utilities including business days, leap years, and interval comparisons.

  • Method Details

    • isLeapYear

      public static boolean isLeapYear(int year)
      Determines whether a given year is a leap year in the Gregorian calendar. Rules: - Year must be divisible by 4 - If divisible by 100, must also be divisible by 400
      Parameters:
      year - the year (e.g., 2024, 2000, 1900)
      Returns:
      true if leap year, false otherwise

    • calculateDaysBetween

      public static long calculateDaysBetween(LocalDate start, LocalDate end)
      Calculates the total number of days between two dates (inclusive of start, exclusive of end). If start is after end, returns negative days.
      Parameters:
      start - start date (non-null)
      end - end date (non-null)
      Returns:
      number of days between
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if either date is null

    • isWeekend

      public static boolean isWeekend(LocalDate date)
      Determines whether a given date falls on a weekend (Saturday or Sunday).
      Parameters:
      date - the date to check
      Returns:
      true if weekend, false if Monday-Friday
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if date is null

    • calculateBusinessDaysBetween

      public static int calculateBusinessDaysBetween(LocalDate start, LocalDate end)
      Calculates the number of business days (Monday through Friday) between two dates. Starts counting from 'start' (inclusive) up to 'end' (exclusive). If start and end are equal, returns 0. If start is after end, returns 0.
      Parameters:
      start - start date
      end - end date
      Returns:
      number of business days
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if either date is null

    • addBusinessDays

      public static LocalDate addBusinessDays(LocalDate start, int days)
      Adds a given number of business days (skipping Saturday and Sunday) to a starting date.
      Parameters:
      start - start date
      days - number of business days to add (must be >= 0)
      Returns:
      resulting LocalDate after adding business days
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if start is null or days is negative

    • doIntervalsOverlap

      public static boolean doIntervalsOverlap(LocalDate start1, LocalDate end1, LocalDate start2, LocalDate end2)
      Determines whether two closed date intervals [start1, end1] and [start2, end2] overlap.
      Parameters:
      start1 - start of first interval
      end1 - end of first interval (must be >= start1)
      start2 - start of second interval
      end2 - end of second interval (must be >= start2)
      Returns:
      true if intervals overlap, false otherwise
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any date is null or start is after end in either interval

    • isDateInRange

      public static boolean isDateInRange(LocalDate date, LocalDate min, LocalDate max)
      Checks if a target date is within a given date range [min, max] (inclusive).
      Parameters:
      date - target date
      min - range start
      max - range end (must be >= min)
      Returns:
      true if target is between min and max inclusive
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any argument is null or min is after max
